newsitem.title: UK: Tame UK inflation, U.S. rebound, prompt FTSE rally.
newsitem.headline: Tame UK inflation, U.S. rebound, prompt FTSE rally.

text.p: UK shares closed sharply higher on Monday, buoyed by the latest batch of subdued price data, which lessened the fear of an imminent rise in UK interest rates, and further helped by Friday's strong rebound on Wall Street.

The FTSE 100 index closed at the day's best level, up 50.7 points at 4,107.3, and within reach of the December 31 high of 4,118.5. Gainers were in a three-to-one majority, with banks and insurance stocks leading the advance. Mid-250 stocks added 27.1 points to end at 4,534.9.
Gilts supported stocks after the December's PPI report showed core factory gate prices up just 0.1 percent.
